title: Mechanisms of Action of Photo(Chemo)Therapy in Skin Diseases
brief_summary: The molecular mechanisms of action of photo(chemo)therapy in skin diseases are investigated in this study. The phototherapeutic modalities employed include UVB (ultraviolet B), UVA (ultraviolet A), PUVA (psoralen+UVA) and/or extracorporeal photochemotherapy (photopheresis). The study will address whether and how photo(chemo)therapy affects specific biologic pathways in different skin disorders and search for predictive biomarkers.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age \> 18 years
* Skin disorder to be treated with photo(chemo)therapy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy and breastfeeding
* Poor general health status
